reason: Both conversations correctly cleared the filter and clogged vent hose before escalating to an engineer, but Conversation 1 kept its diagnosis honest throughout: it never named a specific component as the culprit, explicitly noted that a tripped cut-out implies an underlying airflow cause, and declined to recommend parts without testing. Conversation 2 headlined 'Failed heater element' with no evidence, told the customer to pull the rear panel and eyeball the coil (an unreliable test), and implied a 'reset' on a one-shot cut-out, before only reaching the right engineer escalation once the customer said they could not access the back or test. Conversation 1's repeated unplug-and-cool reminders and refusal to speculate on parts better matched the safety boundary and the genuine uncertainty, outweighing Conversation 2's slightly more efficient question bundling and a minor irrelevant heat-pump aside in Conversation 1.
